entries.description: A six-flag rubric and escalation ladder that a coding agent follows at dispatch time to route each unit of work to the cheapest model tier that passes objective verification. Free, MIT licensed. Install with `npx skills add undercutsh/firstpass`.
Source repository: the skill, the vendor-constant deterministic eval harness (evals/), and the raw public benchmark results (testing/).
Agent-facing navigation index: what Undercut is, when to use it, benchmark summary, and links to docs.
OpenAPI 3.1 description of Undercut's read-only public JSON API. Every operation is an unauthenticated GET; there are no write endpoints and no auth flow.

attestations: CI checks every documented path against its handler and every handler's real response against its documented schema (scripts/validate-openapi.js)

entries.description: Read-only, unauthenticated JSON over data Undercut already publishes: the routing policy (/api/policy), the tier-to-model mapping (/api/models), benchmark results computed from the raw files in testing/results (/api/results), supported clients (/api/clients, /api/clients/{slug}), the setup segment router (/api/segments), pricing (/api/pricing), and published Teams onboarding windows (/api/teams-availability). CORS is open. It does not route, proxy, or run model calls.

attestations: every response is generated from files published in the repository (scripts/build-api-data.js, staleness-checked in CI)

notes: The free tier is a static policy file, not a running service: routing happens inside your own agent. A read-only, unauthenticated JSON API (described at https://getundercut.sh/openapi.json) serves data that is already published in the repository; it has no write endpoints, no auth flow, and no routing or inference endpoint. No MCP server or SDK exists yet. Claude Code can install the policy as a plugin (`/plugin marketplace add undercutsh/firstpass`); every other client uses the skill file directly.
